statement: The proportion of SUID cases with high maternal weight gain during pregnancy varies by pre-pregnancy BMI category.
rationale: This design can compare proportions or odds within the case series but cannot establish causation or estimate incidence rates due to the lack of a denominator source.
prior_art: suid_literature_abstracts.C10 indicates maternal obesity increases SUID risk, but does not examine weight gain during pregnancy. The interaction between pre-pregnancy BMI and weight gain remains unexplored.
cannot_establish: incidence rates or causal relationships between maternal weight gain during pregnancy and pre-pregnancy BMI in relation to SUID risk.
